source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cryptocurrencies and smart contracts (PDF 164).

blocks.text: Cryptocurrencies riwayati bankon ke baghair chalne wali digital currencies hain, jo duniya bhar mein logon ke darmiyan seedhi transactions mumkin banati hain. Smart contracts code mein likhe muahide hain jo muqarrar sharait poori hone par khud chal jate hain. Mil kar yeh payments aur muahidon ke mehfooz, shaffaf aur kaarkard tareeqe dete hain.

blocks.explanation: Yeh sharait poori hone par apni shartein khud amal mein lata hai, baghair kisi shakhs ya darmiyani ke.

items: Cryptocurrencies: bankon ke baghair digital paisa. Smart contracts: khud chalne wale coded muahide.
